pattern: union two differently-headered tables after renaming, pivot with conditional aggregation
question: centre wise attendance percentage for 2023 and 2024 side by side
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre ORDER BY centre
sql_duckdb: SELECT COALESCE(t23."Centre", t24."centre_name") AS "Centre", SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t23."Month" IS NULL THEN (t23."Avg Daily Present" * 1.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(t23."Enrolled Kids", 0), 0)) * 100 ELSE NULL END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT t23."Month" IS NULL THEN t23."Month" END), 0) AS "Attendance Percentage 2023", SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t24."month" IS NULL THEN (t24."average_attendance" * 1.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(t24."enrolment", 0), 0)) * 100 ELSE NULL END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT t24."month" IS NULL THEN t24."month" END), 0) AS "Attendance Percentage 2024" FROM "attendance_2023" AS t23 FULL OUTER JOIN "attendance_2024" AS t24 ON JARO_WINKLER_SIMILARITY(LOWER(TRIM(t23."Centre")), LOWER(TRIM(t24."centre_name"))) >= 0.9 GROUP BY COALESCE(t23."Centre", t24."centre_name")

attempts.prompt:
You translate ordinary questions into exactly one read-only DuckDB SELECT or WITH query.

Return SQL only. Never write files, install software, calculate values yourself, or invent columns.

Use only the supplied schema. Preserve relevant scope from earlier turns unless the newest question changes it.

A requested rate must use its stated numerator and denominator. Percentage-point change means later percentage minus earlier percentage, not relative growth.

When the user explicitly asks for percent or percentage, multiply numerator divided by denominator by 100.

When the user asks to compare years or groups without asking for a change, keep those year/group columns and requested measures in the output.

When several known category values are named, filter them separately with IN rather than concatenating them.

Use NULLIF for denominators. Missing values remain missing and are not zero.

Quote column names with double quotes when they contain spaces or odd characters. When two tables describe the same thing with different column names, UNION ALL them with aligned aliases.

For approximate name matching across tables use jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a)), lower(trim(b))) >= 0.9.

CREATE TABLE "attendance_2023" (

);

CREATE TABLE "attendance_2024" (
  "centre_name" VARCHAR,
  "month" VARCHAR,
  "enrolment" BIGINT,
  "average_attendance" BIGINT
);

centre wise attendance percentage for 2023 and 2024 side by side
attempts.response:
SELECT
  COALESCE(t23."Centre", t24."centre_name") AS "Centre",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t23."Month" IS NOT NULL THEN (t23."Avg Daily Present" * 1.0 / NULLIF(t23."Enrolled Kids", 0)) * 100 ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t23."Month" IS NOT NULL THEN t23."Month" END) AS "Attendance Percentage 2023",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t24."month" IS NOT NULL THEN (t24."average_attendance" * 1.0 / NULLIF(t24."enrolment", 0)) * 100 ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t24."month" IS NOT NULL THEN t24."month" END) AS "Attendance Percentage 2024"
FROM "attendance_2023" t23
FULL OUTER JOIN "attendance_2024" t24
  ON jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(t23."Centre")), lower(trim(t24."centre_name"))) >= 0.9
GROUP BY COALESCE(t23."Centre", t24."centre_name");
